description.zh:
安装云监控插件时所需要的AccessKey。您可以调用[DescribeMonitoringAgentAccessKey](~~114948~~)接口获取该参数。

> 仅非阿里云服务器安装云监控插件需要设置此参数。
description.en:
The AccessKey required to install the CloudMonitor agent. You can call the [DescribeMonitoringAgentAccessKey](~~114948~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

> This parameter is required only when you install the CloudMonitor agent on a non-Alibaba Cloud server.

description.zh:
安装云监控插件时所需要的AccessSecret。您可以调用[DescribeMonitoringAgentAccessKey](~~114948~~)接口获取该参数。
> 仅非阿里云服务器安装云监控插件需要设置此参数。
description.en:
The AccessSecret required to install the CloudMonitor agent. You can call the [DescribeMonitoringAgentAccessKey](~~114948~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
> This parameter is required only when you install the CloudMonitor agent on a non-Alibaba Cloud server.

description.zh: 要安装的云监控插件的版本。您可以通过[插件概览](~~183431~~)获取最新的云监控插件版本。
description.en: The version of the CloudMonitor agent to install. You can obtain the latest CloudMonitor agent version from [Plugin overview](~~183431~~).

description.zh: 要安装云监控插件的服务器的实例ID列表。多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The list of instance IDs of the servers on which you want to install the CloudMonitor agent. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

description.zh: 要安装云监控插件的服务器的UUID列表。多个UUID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The list of UUIDs of the servers on which you want to install the CloudMonitor agent. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).

descriptions.zh: > 安装前请确保您的服务器上的云安全中心客户端在线，并且您的服务器的网络可以正常访问阿里云服务。
descriptions.en: > Before installation, make sure that the Security Center client on your server is online and that your server can access Alibaba Cloud services over the network.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas install-cloud-monitor --argus-version 3.5.6 --agent-access-key usY00000R_U --agent-secret-key UCxF2R1sIO90XlU90000 --instance-id-list VMware-564d4e22ce6d9207-c97c8af3a4480000 --uuid-list inet-c669e5d9-0adf-4d71-a9ce-65ed27300000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas InstallCloudMonitor --region cn-hangzhou --UuidList.1 'inet-c669e5d9-0adf-4d71-a9ce-65ed27300000' --AgentAccessKey usY00000R_U --AgentSecretKey UCxF2R1sIO90XlU90000 --ArgusVersion '3.5.6' --InstanceIdList.1 'VMware-564d4e22ce6d9207-c97c8af3a4480000'
